title: On the fundamental solutions of two nonlocal parabolic equations related to logarithmic Laplacians
summary: We answer in the affirmative a question posed by V. Maz'ya of whether one can continue as a meromorphic function of $t$ the series representation of the fundamental solution of a certain nonlocal parabolic equation associated to a logarithmic Laplacian on the circle, which arises in the study of boundary value problems associated to the ordinary Laplacian on domains with thin cavities.
